migrationCompatibility.notes: No schema change. Only the string written into an existing JSON payload field changes. Rows written by the prior release remain readable and render as they did.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: redeploy the prior release; summaries revert to carrying internal detail, which is the current state. Rows already written keep the safe copy — the change is not retroactive in either direction.

acceptanceCommands: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests -m 'not live and not demo_contract' -q
doNotInfer: Do not discard the internal detail when replacing the seller-facing string. Operators need the diagnosis; the seller must not receive it. Log one, show the other.

Do not add a stop reason to the copy map without checking BOTH TypeScript maps — STOP_REASONS and WORKFLOW_FAILED_STOP_REASON_TO_STATUS. ADR-088 split concluded_without_changes and required_steps_unfulfilled out of final_response, and checking one map has produced a false green here before.
Do not invent Vietnamese tone. The reviewed vocabulary lives in docs/product/design and the dictionary; seller-facing copy is a product artifact, not a developer string.
Do not route around the outbound guard to get copy out. If a path needs to bypass it, that is the finding, not the workaround.
